The full task requires connected writing of at least 150 words; a short overview exercise develops one component and is not a complete response.
body.ru: В Academic Task 1 до письма определите категории, даты, показатель и единицы. Сравните начало и конец, затем проверьте смену мест. Сформулируйте обзор главных закономерностей без перечисления всех значений. Группируйте подробности по смыслу: совместный рост или противоположное движение одной категории. Подкрепляйте сравнения достаточными числами, не выдумывая причин. Отличайте количества от процентов. Полное задание требует связного текста минимум из 150 слов; короткое упражнение на обзор развивает один компонент и не является полным ответом.

workedExample.en: Original mini-table, digital editions in thousands, 2015 → 2025: Larch Library 8 → 14; Ash Library 17 → 13; Elm Library 5 → 9. Overview excerpt: “Larch and Elm expanded their digital collections, whereas Ash’s collection became smaller. Larch overtook Ash to hold the largest collection by 2025.” Both comparisons follow from the table. Try independently: add one data sentence about the change in ranking. Self-check: “Larch rose from 8,000 to 14,000 editions, while Ash fell from 17,000 to 13,000.” Do not claim a funding policy caused these changes; none is given.
workedExample.ru: Авторская мини-таблица, цифровые издания в тысячах, 2015 → 2025: Larch Library 8 → 14; Ash Library 17 → 13; Elm Library 5 → 9. Фрагмент обзора: “Larch and Elm expanded their digital collections, whereas Ash’s collection became smaller. Larch overtook Ash to hold the largest collection by 2025.” Сравнения следуют из таблицы. Самостоятельно: добавьте числовое предложение о смене лидера. Самопроверка: “Larch rose from 8,000 to 14,000 editions, while Ash fell from 17,000 to 13,000.” Не объясняйте это политикой финансирования: она не указана.

title.en: Describe stages, branches, and endpoints
title.ru: Описывайте этапы, ветвления и конечные результаты

body.en: A process response should explain how the supplied stages connect. Identify the starting input, final output, and any branches or repeated cycle. An overview can describe the overall movement and a major division without inventing a purpose that the diagram does not show. Use sequence markers where they help, not at the start of every sentence. Passive forms are useful when the material matters more than an unnamed operator, but they are not compulsory in every sentence. Keep the tense appropriate to a general process. Do not add timing, temperatures, transport, or recycling steps unless the visual includes them.
body.ru: Описание процесса должно объяснять связь заданных этапов. Определите вход, конечный выход, ветвления и возможный цикл. Обзор может назвать общее движение и главное разделение без выдуманной цели. Используйте последовательные связки там, где они помогают, не обязательно в каждом предложении. Страдательный залог полезен, когда материал важнее неназванного исполнителя, но не обязателен повсюду. Для общего процесса выбирайте подходящее время. Не добавляйте длительность, температуры, перевозку или переработку, отсутствующие на схеме.

workedExample.en: Original text diagram: harvested apples → washing → inspection; acceptable apples → packing; damaged apples → composting. Overview excerpt: “After washing, the apples are inspected and separated into two groups, leading either to packing or to composting.” This captures the shared beginning and the branch. Try independently: write one sentence describing the acceptable branch. Self-check: “Apples that pass inspection are packed.” Claiming that every apple is packed would erase the other branch; saying that compost is returned to the orchard would invent an unshown loop. These are process-writing excerpts, not a complete 150-word response.
workedExample.ru: Авторская текстовая схема: harvested apples → washing → inspection; acceptable apples → packing; damaged apples → composting. Фрагмент обзора: “After washing, the apples are inspected and separated into two groups, leading either to packing or to composting.” Он отражает общее начало и ветвление. Самостоятельно: опишите ветку пригодных яблок одним предложением. Самопроверка: “Apples that pass inspection are packed.” Упаковка всех яблок стирает вторую ветку; возврат компоста в сад выдумывает неуказанный цикл. Это фрагменты обучения процессу, не полный ответ из 150 слов.

title.en: Plan for every part of a Task 2 question
title.ru: Планируйте ответ на каждую часть Task 2

body.en: Underline the task instructions separately from the topic. A question asking for both views and your opinion requires all three, while a causes-and-solutions question requires a different plan. Write a one-sentence position, then assign each paragraph a purpose that helps answer the actual question. Acknowledge another view accurately before explaining your response to it. Your opinion can be conditional, but its conditions must be clear and consistent through the conclusion. Do not use a memorized essay merely because it shares a topic word. The full response needs at least 250 words; a plan is preparation, not the response itself.
body.ru: Подчеркните требования отдельно от темы. Вопрос с двумя взглядами и вашим мнением требует всех трёх компонентов; причинам и решениям нужен другой план. Запишите позицию одним предложением и назначьте каждому абзацу роль в ответе на настоящий вопрос. Перед реакцией точно представьте чужой взгляд. Мнение может быть условным, но условия должны быть ясны и сохраняться в выводе. Не используйте заученное эссе только из-за общего тематического слова. Полный ответ требует минимум 250 слов; план — подготовка, не сам ответ.

workedExample.en: Original prompt: “Some people support timed entry to popular natural areas; others think visitors should enter freely. Discuss both views and give your opinion.” A focused plan considers crowd management, concerns about excluding spontaneous visitors, and an opinion favoring reservations at peak periods with some walk-up access. Each element has a role in the requested discussion. Try independently: does a paragraph about the history of hiking answer a required part? Self-check: not by itself. It needs a clear link to the access question; otherwise use the space to explain how the proposed balance would work.
workedExample.ru: Авторское задание: “Some people support timed entry to popular natural areas; others think visitors should enter freely. Discuss both views and give your opinion.” Целевой план рассматривает управление потоком, опасение исключить незапланированных посетителей и мнение в пользу записи в пиковое время с частью мест без брони. Каждый элемент выполняет требование обсуждения. Самостоятельно: отвечает ли абзац об истории походов на нужную часть? Самопроверка: сам по себе нет. Нужна ясная связь с доступом; иначе лучше объяснить, как работает предлагаемый баланс.

title.en: Develop a reason instead of repeating it

body.en: A Task 2 paragraph should move beyond announcing that something is beneficial or harmful. State a relevant point, explain the mechanism linking it to the question, and use a concrete example or plausible situation to make that mechanism clear. Then connect the implication back to your position. These are reasoning functions, not a compulsory four-sentence template. Avoid invented research statistics or unnamed experts used as decoration. A personal or hypothetical example can support an explanation when presented honestly and relevantly. Check that every sentence adds information rather than restating the point with a different adjective.
body.ru: Абзац Task 2 должен идти дальше заявления о пользе или вреде. Назовите относящийся к вопросу тезис, объясните механизм связи и проясните его конкретным примером или правдоподобной ситуацией. Затем свяжите следствие с позицией. Это функции рассуждения, не обязательный шаблон четырёх предложений. Не выдумывайте статистику исследований и неназванных экспертов для украшения. Личный или гипотетический пример полезен, если честно обозначен и уместен. Проверяйте, добавляет ли каждое предложение сведения вместо повторения тезиса новым прилагательным.

workedExample.en: Original paragraph excerpt: “Teaching basic repair skills can make students less likely to discard usable belongings. A pupil who can replace a broken zip may keep a jacket that would otherwise be thrown away. The lesson therefore links a practical skill with a specific way to reduce avoidable waste.” The zip example explains the route from skill to outcome; “repair is very useful” alone would not. Try independently: add a limitation about school time. Self-check: a relevant addition is “Such lessons would need a manageable place in the timetable, perhaps within an existing practical subject.” This is one paragraph excerpt, not a complete essay.
workedExample.ru: Авторский фрагмент абзаца: “Teaching basic repair skills can make students less likely to discard usable belongings. A pupil who can replace a broken zip may keep a jacket that would otherwise be thrown away. The lesson therefore links a practical skill with a specific way to reduce avoidable waste.” Пример молнии объясняет путь от навыка к результату; repair is very useful этого не делает. Самостоятельно: добавьте ограничение учебного времени. Самопроверка: “Such lessons would need a manageable place in the timetable, perhaps within an existing practical subject.” Это фрагмент абзаца, не полное эссе.

title.en: Edit meaning, organization, and language separately
title.ru: Редактируйте смысл, организацию и язык отдельно

body.en: Use separate editing passes so a corrected verb does not distract from an unanswered question. First check task coverage and the consistency of the main position or overview. Next check paragraph order and whether pronouns have clear referents. Then examine word choice for accurate meaning, collocation, and countability. Finally check sentence boundaries and agreement. IELTS Writing considers task achievement or response, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical range and accuracy; these are broader than counting errors. Choose a few specific revisions supported by the text. Practice feedback should explain the effect of an edit without converting a short excerpt into an official band.
body.ru: Используйте отдельные проходы, чтобы исправленный глагол не отвлекал от неотвеченного вопроса. Сначала проверьте охват задания и последовательность позиции или обзора. Затем — порядок абзацев и ясность местоименных отсылок. После этого — точность слов, сочетаемость и исчисляемость. В конце — границы предложений и согласование. IELTS Writing учитывает выполнение задания/раскрытие темы, связность, лексику и диапазон с точностью грамматики; это шире подсчёта ошибок. Выбирайте конкретные обоснованные изменения. Тренировочный разбор объясняет эффект правки, не превращая короткий фрагмент в официальный band.

workedExample.en: Original draft: “These equipment saves time, workers finishes tasks faster.” Equipment is normally uncountable here, so use this equipment; workers requires finish; the comma also joins two complete clauses incorrectly. A more developed revision is “This equipment saves time because its guide holds each sheet in position, reducing repeated adjustments.” The revision fixes form and explains a mechanism instead of merely repeating faster work. Try independently: edit “The two machines works reliably.” Self-check: “The two machines work reliably.” Do not infer that fixing this sentence proves the whole essay meets every criterion.
workedExample.ru: Авторский черновик: “These equipment saves time, workers finishes tasks faster.” Equipment здесь обычно неисчисляемо: нужно this equipment; workers требует finish; запятая также неправильно соединяет самостоятельные части. Более развитая правка: “This equipment saves time because its guide holds each sheet in position, reducing repeated adjustments.” Она исправляет форму и объясняет механизм вместо повторения быстроты работы. Самостоятельно: исправьте “The two machines works reliably.” Самопроверка: “The two machines work reliably.” Исправление одной фразы не доказывает выполнение всех критериев целым эссе.

title.en: Extend a Part 1 answer without losing the question
title.ru: Развивайте ответ Part 1, сохраняя связь с вопросом

body.en: Part 1 asks about familiar experiences and everyday topics. Begin with a direct answer, then add a relevant reason, example, or small contrast when it helps the listener understand you. The amount of detail should fit the question; there is no need to force the same number of sentences into every response. Avoid an unrelated prepared speech. Practise changing the question slightly so you must adapt the content rather than repeat a script. Record two short answers and listen for whether the main answer arrives early and the added detail is connected. Fluency does not mean speaking as quickly as possible.
body.ru: Part 1 касается знакомого опыта и повседневных тем. Начните с прямого ответа, затем при необходимости добавьте связанную причину, пример или небольшой контраст. Объём зависит от вопроса; одинаковое число предложений в каждом ответе не требуется. Избегайте посторонней заготовленной речи. Немного меняйте вопрос при тренировке, чтобы адаптировать содержание вместо повторения сценария. Запишите два коротких ответа и проверьте, рано ли появляется главное и связано ли добавление. Беглость не означает максимально быструю речь.

workedExample.en: Original question: “What do you keep on your desk?” Possible answer: “Usually just a notebook and a lamp. I put other things away because I find a clear surface easier to work on.” The answer identifies objects and explains the arrangement. Try independently: answer the different question “Has your desk arrangement changed?” Self-check: your response should now include a change or state that it has stayed similar, with a relevant detail. Repeating the original answer without addressing change would miss the question. The example is one possible response, not a script to memorize.
workedExample.ru: Авторский вопрос: “What do you keep on your desk?” Возможный ответ: “Usually just a notebook and a lamp. I put other things away because I find a clear surface easier to work on.” Названы предметы и объяснён порядок. Самостоятельно: ответьте на другой вопрос — “Has your desk arrangement changed?” Самопроверка: теперь нужно описать изменение или сказать, что всё осталось похожим, добавив деталь. Повторение прежнего ответа без обсуждения изменения пропустит вопрос. Образец — один возможный ответ, не текст для заучивания.

title.en: Use preparation notes to build a sustained long turn
title.ru: Используйте заметки для связного длинного ответа

body.en: For Part 2, use the preparation minute to select one workable example and organize keywords around the cue card’s points. Notes should remind you of content rather than contain sentences you must read aloud. Give the listener an opening orientation, develop the main events or details, and explain the requested significance. Aim to sustain a coherent talk for up to two minutes rather than stopping after a list of nouns. If one detail is forgotten, continue with another relevant detail. In practice, record the full turn; evaluate how well it develops the topic rather than treating the brief opening shown below as a complete answer.
body.ru: В Part 2 используйте минуту подготовки для выбора подходящего примера и ключевых слов по пунктам карточки. Заметки напоминают содержание, а не дают предложения для чтения. Сначала сориентируйте слушателя, затем развивайте события или детали и объясните требуемое значение. Стремитесь связно говорить до двух минут, не останавливаясь после списка существительных. Если деталь забыта, продолжайте другой уместной. На тренировке запишите полный ответ; оценивайте развитие темы, не принимая короткое начало ниже за завершённую речь.

workedExample.en: Original cue: “Describe something you learned to make. Say what it was, who helped you, how you learned, and why the experience mattered.” Notes: paper kite / neighbour / first frame bent / lighter paper / first successful flight / patience. Opening excerpt: “I learned to make a small kite with a neighbour. My first frame bent, so we rebuilt it and tried lighter paper.” The next part should describe the successful attempt and its significance. Try independently: take one minute to plan a different making experience, then record up to two minutes. Self-check: cover the cue and connect the details; do not copy this kite story.
workedExample.ru: Авторская карточка: “Describe something you learned to make. Say what it was, who helped you, how you learned, and why the experience mattered.” Заметки: paper kite / neighbour / first frame bent / lighter paper / first successful flight / patience. Фрагмент начала: “I learned to make a small kite with a neighbour. My first frame bent, so we rebuilt it and tried lighter paper.” Далее нужны успешная попытка и её значение. Самостоятельно: за минуту спланируйте другой опыт изготовления и запишите до двух минут речи. Самопроверка: раскройте карточку и свяжите детали; не копируйте историю змея.

title.en: Move from a personal example to a wider explanation
title.ru: Переходите от личного примера к общему объяснению

body.en: Part 3 moves toward broader discussion, explanation, comparison, and speculation. Answer the general question before using a personal example. Give a reason that connects the example to the wider claim, and qualify the claim when circumstances can differ. Words such as may, often, and in some settings help express appropriate limits, but they should reflect what you mean rather than fill time. You do not need invented statistics to sound analytical. Compare groups or conditions explicitly when the question asks for differences. Finish a line of reasoning before introducing a second idea; a series of unconnected examples is difficult to follow.
body.ru: Part 3 переходит к общему обсуждению, объяснению, сравнению и предположениям. Ответьте на общий вопрос до личного примера. Объясните связь примера с широким тезисом и ограничьте тезис, когда обстоятельства различаются. May, often и in some settings помогают передать границы, но должны выражать смысл, не заполнять время. Для анализа не нужна выдуманная статистика. Явно сравнивайте группы или условия, если спрашиваются различия. Завершайте рассуждение перед новой мыслью: набор несвязанных примеров трудно воспринимать.

workedExample.en: Original question: “Why might communities keep traditional games?” Possible opening: “They can give different generations an activity to share. If older residents teach the rules to children, the game creates an opportunity for conversation as well as play. This may work best when the rules are easy for newcomers to learn.” The example supports a general reason and adds a condition. Try independently: discuss one reason a game might become less popular. Self-check: connect a factor such as lack of suitable space to its effect on participation, rather than only naming a game you dislike.
workedExample.ru: Авторский вопрос: “Why might communities keep traditional games?” Возможное начало: “They can give different generations an activity to share. If older residents teach the rules to children, the game creates an opportunity for conversation as well as play. This may work best when the rules are easy for newcomers to learn.” Пример поддерживает общую причину и добавляет условие. Самостоятельно: обсудите причину снижения популярности игры. Самопроверка: свяжите, например, нехватку подходящего места с участием, вместо простого названия нелюбимой игры.

title.en: Keep meaning moving when a word is missing
title.ru: Сохраняйте мысль, когда нужное слово забыто

body.en: If a word is unavailable, explain the object’s category, function, appearance, or relation to something familiar. Choose the shortest accurate description that lets the listener follow your idea. Effective paraphrase is more useful than inserting an uncertain rare word. If you notice a factual or grammatical slip, make a brief repair and continue; repeatedly restarting an entire answer can break its development. During review, distinguish useful self-correction from a habit of correcting every harmless variation. Practise describing familiar objects without naming them, then check whether another person could identify what you mean. This develops flexible language rather than a memorized list of substitutes.
body.ru: Если слово забыто, опишите категорию предмета, функцию, вид или связь со знакомым. Выберите краткое точное описание, позволяющее следить за мыслью. Удачный перифраз полезнее неуверенного редкого слова. Заметив фактическую или грамматическую оговорку, коротко исправьтесь и продолжайте; постоянный перезапуск ответа разрушает развитие. При разборе отличайте полезную самокоррекцию от привычки исправлять безвредные варианты. Описывайте знакомые предметы без названия, затем проверяйте, можно ли их распознать. Это развивает гибкость языка, не список заученных замен.

workedExample.en: Original situation: you cannot recall “insulated flask.” You can say, “a bottle that keeps a drink warm for several hours,” and continue explaining why you use it. The description identifies function without claiming that the bottle heats the drink itself. Try independently: describe a receipt without using that word. Self-check: “the paper or digital record that shows what you bought and paid” preserves its purpose. Also practise a short correction: “I bought it on Sunday—sorry, Saturday—before the trip.” The repair changes the detail while allowing the story to continue.
workedExample.ru: Авторская ситуация: забыто insulated flask. Можно сказать “a bottle that keeps a drink warm for several hours” и продолжить объяснение пользы. Описание даёт функцию, не утверждая, что бутылка сама нагревает напиток. Самостоятельно: опишите receipt без этого слова. Самопроверка: “the paper or digital record that shows what you bought and paid” сохраняет назначение. Потренируйте короткое исправление: “I bought it on Sunday—sorry, Saturday—before the trip.” Меняется деталь, но история продолжается.

title.en: Review intelligibility from the recording

body.en: Pronunciation is assessed through speech, not through written transcription. Keep your original recording and listen for whether a listener can understand key words and follow the intended grouping of ideas. Mark a few useful phrase boundaries and stress words that carry a contrast. Speak at a manageable pace; removing every pause or imitating a particular accent is not the aim. A transcript can help review organization and wording, but it cannot establish sound clarity, rhythm, or pronunciation performance. Correct recognition errors before using a transcript for language feedback. Use the audio checklist as practice guidance, never as an automatic pronunciation band.
body.ru: Произношение оценивается по речи, не по письменной расшифровке. Сохраните исходную запись и проверьте понятность ключевых слов и группировку мыслей для слушателя. Отметьте несколько полезных границ фраз и ударные слова контраста. Говорите в удобном темпе; цель не в устранении всех пауз и не в подражании определённому акценту. Транскрипт помогает проверить организацию и лексику, но не устанавливает ясность звуков, ритм или качество произношения. Исправьте ошибки распознавания до языкового разбора. Аудиочек-лист даёт тренировочные ориентиры, не автоматический pronunciation band.

workedExample.en: Original practice sentence: “I borrowed the green umbrella, not the black one, because mine was broken.” Record it once, grouping the contrast together. Listen for whether green and black are distinguishable and whether the reason remains connected to the borrowing. Try independently: record a second version contrasting borrowed with bought while keeping the rest relevant. Self-check: the intended contrast should be audible without relying on capital letters in a transcript. Then choose one improvement and rerecord. A perfectly spelled transcript alone cannot confirm that either recording was intelligible.
workedExample.ru: Авторская тренировочная фраза: “I borrowed the green umbrella, not the black one, because mine was broken.” Запишите её, объединяя контраст в смысловую группу. Проверьте различимость green и black и связь причины с заимствованием. Самостоятельно: запишите версию с противопоставлением borrowed и bought, сохранив остальное уместным. Самопроверка: контраст должен быть слышен без опоры на прописные буквы транскрипта. Затем выберите одно улучшение и перезапишите. Безошибочное написание в расшифровке само по себе не подтверждает понятность записи.

exercises.prompt: Which statement best expresses the main idea?
options: Borrowing tools can make occasional repairs more affordable.
All households need to buy more tools.
Tool libraries repair every borrowed item.
acceptedAnswers: Borrowing tools can make occasional repairs more affordable.

explanation.en: The example shows how shared tools avoid the cost of buying equipment needed only occasionally. The other options add unsupported claims.
explanation.ru: Пример показывает, как общие инструменты позволяют не покупать оборудование для редких работ. Остальные варианты добавляют неподтверждённые утверждения.

exercises.prompt: Which finding most directly supports the researchers’ explanation?
options: Both ponds contained several plant species.

The ponds were visited by different birds.

options: Room A had more paintings than Room B.

acceptedAnswers: Average viewing time was longer with the new labels in both rooms.

explanation.ru: Время просмотра выросло с 22 до 31 секунды в A и с 28 до 35 в B. Таблица измеряет время, а не предпочтения, посещаемость или число картин.

exercises.prompt: Which statement best describes a limitation of the result?
options: The survey excluded people who did not visit during the sampled evenings.
The result cannot describe any evening visitors.
The result shows that daytime visitors oppose the change.
The survey proves that longer opening hours caused every new visit.
acceptedAnswers: The survey excluded people who did not visit during the sampled evenings.

explanation.en: Only evening visitors were sampled. Nonvisitors’ views and behavior remain unknown, so the result cannot establish everyone’s response.
explanation.ru: Опрашивали только вечерних посетителей. Мнения и поведение непосетителей неизвестны, поэтому результат нельзя распространять на реакцию всех жителей.

hints.ru: Кто из важной группы не мог попасть в выборку?

explanation.ru: Умножим первое уравнение на 3: 9x + 6y = 36. Второе совпадёт с ним только при k = 6.

hints.en: Find two numbers whose product is 20 and sum is 9.
hints.ru: Найдите два числа с произведением 20 и суммой 9.

exercises.prompt: The function f(x) = (x − 3)² + 8 has a minimum value. What is that value?

explanation.en: A square is never negative, and it is zero at x = 3. Thus the minimum output is 8.
explanation.ru: Квадрат неотрицателен и равен нулю при x = 3. Поэтому минимальное значение функции — 8.

hints.en: What is the smallest possible value of a square?
hints.ru: Каково наименьшее значение квадрата?

hints.en: Distinguish the input 3 from the output 8.
hints.ru: Отличайте аргумент 3 от значения 8.

typicalErrors.en: Confusing the vertex’s x-coordinate with the minimum value.
typicalErrors.ru: Смешение x-координаты вершины с минимумом функции.

exercises.prompt: A culture begins with 80 cells and doubles every hour. According to this model, how many cells are present after 3 hours?

explanation.ru: Три удвоения дают 80 × 2³ = 640. Начальная численность соответствует нулевому часу.

hints.en: Count the number of doublings.
hints.ru: Посчитайте число удвоений.

hints.ru: Умножьте 80 на 2 три раза.

exercises.prompt: For x ≠ 5, which expression is equivalent to (x² − 25)/(x − 5)?

explanation.ru: Числитель равен (x − 5)(x + 5). Сократим x − 5, сохранив ограничение x ≠ 5.

hints.en: Recognize a difference of squares.
hints.ru: Узнайте разность квадратов.

hints.en: Cancel a common factor, not separate terms.

typicalErrors.en: Canceling terms across addition or losing the domain restriction.

exercises.prompt: What is the solution of √(x + 6) = x, where the square root is nonnegative?

explanation.en: The original equation requires x ≥ 0. Squaring gives x² − x − 6 = 0, with roots 3 and −2. Only 3 satisfies the original equation: √9 = 3.
explanation.ru: Исходное уравнение требует x ≥ 0. После возведения в квадрат: x² − x − 6 = 0, корни 3 и −2. Только 3 удовлетворяет исходному: √9 = 3.

hints.en: What sign must x have?
hints.ru: Какой знак должен иметь x?

hints.en: After squaring and factoring, test every candidate in the original equation.
hints.ru: После возведения в квадрат и разложения проверьте кандидатов в исходном уравнении.

typicalErrors.en: Accepting an extraneous root introduced by squaring.
typicalErrors.ru: Принятие постороннего корня после возведения в квадрат.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The equation x² − 6x + c = 0 has exactly one distinct real solution. What is c?

explanation.en: Exactly one distinct real root requires the discriminant to be zero: (−6)² − 4c = 0. Thus c = 9 and the expression is (x − 3)².
explanation.ru: Для одного различного действительного корня дискриминант равен нулю: (−6)² − 4c = 0. Значит, c = 9 и выражение равно (x − 3)².

hints.en: Use the condition for a repeated root.
hints.ru: Используйте условие кратного корня.

hints.en: Set b² − 4ac equal to zero.
hints.ru: Приравняйте b² − 4ac к нулю.

typicalErrors.en: Using a positive discriminant for exactly one distinct real solution.
typicalErrors.ru: Положительный дискриминант для одного различного действительного корня.

exercises.prompt: A group contains 12 members who cycle and 18 who do not. Of the cyclists, 9 wear helmets. A cyclist is selected at random. What is the probability that this person wears a helmet? Enter a fraction or decimal.

exercises.prompt: A school randomly assigns 100 consenting students to either a new study schedule or the current schedule. Both groups take the same test. What feature most directly supports a causal comparison of the schedules?
options: Students were randomly assigned to schedules.
The school has a large library.
Students chose whether to join the study.
acceptedAnswers: Students were randomly assigned to schedules.

explanation.en: Random assignment tends to balance competing factors between treatment groups, supporting a causal comparison for the study participants. It does not guarantee generalization to all students.
explanation.ru: Случайное распределение помогает уравновесить посторонние факторы между группами и поддерживает причинное сравнение для участников. Оно не гарантирует обобщение на всех учеников.

exercises.prompt: Data set A is 2, 5, 7, 9, 12. Data set B is formed by adding 4 to every value in A. By how much does the median increase?

explanation.en: Adding the same constant preserves the order. The middle value changes from 7 to 11, so the median increases by 4.

hints.en: How does adding a constant affect the ordering?
hints.ru: Как прибавление константы влияет на порядок?

hints.en: Compare the middle values.
hints.ru: Сравните центральные значения.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying the shift by the number of data points.

exercises.prompt: A circle has diameter 10 centimeters. Its area is kπ square centimeters. What is k?

explanation.en: The radius is half the diameter, or 5 cm. Area = πr² = 25π, so k = 25.
explanation.ru: Радиус — половина диаметра: 5 см. Площадь πr² = 25π, поэтому k = 25.

hints.en: Find the radius before using the area formula.
hints.ru: Найдите радиус до применения формулы.

hints.en: Square 5, not 10.
hints.ru: Возведите в квадрат 5, не 10.

typicalErrors.en: Using the diameter as the radius.
typicalErrors.ru: Диаметр вместо радиуса.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A right triangle has legs of length 9 and 12. What is the length of its hypotenuse?

explanation.en: By the Pythagorean theorem, c² = 9² + 12² = 225. The positive length is c = 15.
explanation.ru: По теореме Пифагора c² = 9² + 12² = 225. Положительная длина c = 15.

hints.en: Identify the two legs and the hypotenuse.
hints.ru: Определите катеты и гипотенузу.

hints.en: Take the square root after summing the squared legs.
hints.ru: После сложения квадратов извлеките корень.

typicalErrors.en: Adding the two leg lengths directly.
typicalErrors.ru: Прямое сложение длин катетов.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A cylinder has radius 3 meters and height 5 meters. Its volume is kπ cubic meters. What is k?

explanation.en: Volume = πr²h = π × 3² × 5 = 45π, so k = 45.
explanation.ru: Объём πr²h = π × 3² × 5 = 45π, поэтому k = 45.

hints.en: Use base area times height.
hints.ru: Умножьте площадь основания на высоту.

hints.en: Square the radius, then multiply by 5.
hints.ru: Возведите радиус в квадрат и умножьте на 5.

typicalErrors.en: Using circumference rather than base area.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: Two similar triangles have corresponding side lengths 4 and 10. The smaller triangle has area 24. What is the area of the larger triangle?

explanation.en: The length scale factor is 10/4 = 2.5. The area scale factor is 2.5² = 6.25, so the larger area is 24 × 6.25 = 150.
explanation.ru: Коэффициент длин равен 10/4 = 2,5. Коэффициент площадей 2,5² = 6,25, поэтому большая площадь 24 × 6,25 = 150.

hints.en: Find the scale factor for corresponding lengths.
hints.ru: Найдите коэффициент соответствующих длин.

hints.en: Square that factor for areas.
hints.ru: Для площадей возведите коэффициент в квадрат.

typicalErrors.en: Applying the linear scale factor directly to area.
typicalErrors.ru: Применение линейного коэффициента к площади.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: In a right triangle, an acute angle θ has opposite side 5 and hypotenuse 13. What is cos θ? Enter an exact fraction.

explanation.en: The adjacent side is √(13² − 5²) = 12. Cosine is adjacent/hypotenuse = 12/13.
explanation.ru: Прилежащий катет равен √(13² − 5²) = 12. Косинус равен прилежащему катету, делённому на гипотенузу: 12/13.

hints.en: Find the missing adjacent side.
hints.ru: Найдите отсутствующий прилежащий катет.

hints.en: Cosine uses adjacent divided by hypotenuse.
hints.ru: Косинус — прилежащий катет, делённый на гипотенузу.

typicalErrors.en: Using sine when cosine is requested.
typicalErrors.ru: Синус вместо требуемого косинуса.

exercises.prompt: Two parallel lines are crossed by a transversal. A pair of same-side interior angles measure (3x + 10)° and (5x − 6)°. What is x?

explanation.en: Same-side interior angles are supplementary: 3x + 10 + 5x − 6 = 180. Thus 8x + 4 = 180 and x = 22.
explanation.ru: Односторонние внутренние углы в сумме дают 180°: 3x + 10 + 5x − 6 = 180. Тогда 8x + 4 = 180 и x = 22.

hints.en: Are these angles equal or supplementary?
hints.ru: Эти углы равны или дают в сумме 180°?

hints.en: Set the sum equal to 180.
hints.ru: Приравняйте сумму к 180.

typicalErrors.en: Treating same-side interior angles as corresponding angles.
typicalErrors.ru: Подмена односторонних внутренних углов соответственными.

exercises.sampleAnswer:
Allowing students to choose homework may increase their interest, but teachers also have a responsibility to ensure that essential skills are practised. In my view, students should have a limited choice within a set of tasks designed by the teacher.

Supporters of unrestricted choice argue that learners know which topics interest them. A student who enjoys environmental issues might willingly spend longer researching a local river than completing a general worksheet. Choice can also develop planning skills, because the learner has to decide what to study and how to present the result. However, interest alone does not reveal every learning need. Students may repeatedly avoid a difficult but necessary skill.

Teacher-selected homework can address that problem. A teacher who has reviewed classroom work can identify common weaknesses and assign a focused activity. This makes it easier to check whether the whole class understands an important idea before moving on. Nevertheless, a single identical task may be too easy for some learners and too demanding for others, which can reduce its value.

A balanced approach combines these advantages. For example, after a lesson on evidence, a teacher could offer three short texts on different subjects while requiring every student to support the same kind of argument. Learners would choose a topic, but the underlying skill would remain consistent. The teacher could then give additional targeted practice where needed. This approach preserves meaningful student choice while ensuring that homework contributes to the course rather than merely reflecting existing preferences. Such flexibility also helps students explain why a task matters.

exercises.sampleAnswer:
Publicly supported repair workshops can help residents extend the life of household items. Although such programmes require money and careful organization, I believe their advantages outweigh the disadvantages when they focus on useful skills and operate within a clear budget.

The main benefit is that repair can reduce avoidable waste. A broken handle or loose connection may cause someone to discard an otherwise usable object. In a supervised workshop, the owner can learn a practical method and apply it again later. The value therefore extends beyond the single repaired item. Workshops may also help residents who cannot easily afford replacements, particularly when tools are shared and attendance is inexpensive.

There are, however, real costs. A city must provide suitable space, equipment and competent supervision. Some repairs could also be unsafe if inexperienced participants work without guidance. These concerns are especially serious for electrical appliances. Public funding should not support activities simply because they are popular; authorities need a credible explanation of the likely benefits and the resources required.

The drawbacks can be reduced by defining the programme carefully. A city could begin with a small monthly workshop for low-risk repairs such as clothing and simple furniture. Trained staff could explain which items require a qualified specialist instead. Attendance, completed repairs and participants’ later use of the skills could then inform a decision about expansion.

Overall, the opportunity to reduce waste and teach reusable skills justifies modest public support. The strongest policy would combine accessible instruction with clear safety limits and regular evaluation, rather than treating every household repair as suitable for a community session.

exercises.sampleAnswer:
Museums increasingly provide online collections and interactive digital experiences. These services can reach audiences who cannot visit in person, but physical exhibitions offer qualities that a screen cannot fully reproduce. I believe museums should protect the quality of their physical collections while funding digital access as a complementary service.

The argument for making digital access the main priority rests on reach. A student living far from a major museum may be able to examine a high-resolution image at home without the cost of travel. Digital material can also be enlarged, translated or organized into different learning routes. A well-designed online exhibition may therefore serve people whose needs are not met by a conventional visit. These are substantial benefits, especially for institutions with a geographically dispersed audience.

Supporters of physical exhibitions emphasize the objects themselves. Seeing the scale, surface and arrangement of an artifact can change a visitor’s understanding in ways that a flat image may not capture. Physical collections also require conservation and secure storage whether or not their images are available online. If funding moves away from these responsibilities, the museum may weaken the very collection on which its digital service depends.

A sensible allocation should consider both purposes. For instance, a museum could conserve a fragile textile and display it for limited periods while providing detailed digital views throughout the year. The digital version would improve access without removing the need to preserve the original.

For these reasons, physical collections should remain a central funding responsibility. Digital services deserve sustained investment where they widen access or explain the collection more effectively, but they should be developed alongside conservation and carefully planned exhibitions, rather than replacing them.

Illustrative Part 2 response, not a memorization script: I learned how to repair a bicycle puncture from a neighbor last spring. Before that, I usually took my bike to a shop, even when the problem was small. One weekend the rear tyre went flat just before I planned to visit a friend. Illustrative Part 2 response: A small square near my home was redesigned last year. It used to be mostly paving, with a few benches along one edge. Illustrative Part 2 response: Last autumn, a friend and I decided how to use a free weekend during a short trip. I wanted to visit a science museum, while she preferred walking in the nearby hills. We initially treated it as a choice between two completely different days, so neither of us was very satisfied with the other suggestion.

We then checked the opening times and the weather forecast together. Rain was expected in the morning, but the afternoon looked clearer. The museum opened early and was close to our accommodation. We decided to spend the morning there and take a shorter walk later. This meant giving up the longest walking route, but it allowed us both to do something we enjoyed.

What I learned was that disagreement sometimes becomes easier when people examine practical details instead of repeating their preferences. We did not get everything we first wanted, but the final plan reflected both of our priorities and worked well on the day.

exercises.prompt: A linear function has the values f(1) = 8, f(3) = 14, and f(5) = 20. What is the rate of change of f?

hints.en: Compare changes in outputs with changes in inputs.
hints.ru: Сопоставьте изменения значений функции и аргумента.
Вычислите (14 − 8)/(3 − 1).

explanation.en: The output rises by 6 when the input rises by 2. The rate is 6/2 = 3; both intervals give the same result.
explanation.ru: Значение функции увеличивается на 6 при увеличении аргумента на 2. Скорость изменения равна 6/2 = 3 на обоих промежутках.

typicalErrors.en: Using the change in output without dividing by the change in input.
typicalErrors.ru: Изменение значения функции без деления на изменение аргумента.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: For f(x) = 7 − 2x, what is f(−4)?

hints.en: Replace x with the entire number −4.
hints.ru: Замените x числом −4 вместе со знаком.

hints.en: The product −2 × (−4) is positive.
hints.ru: Произведение −2 × (−4) положительно.

explanation.en: Substitute −4 for x: 7 − 2(−4) = 7 + 8 = 15.
explanation.ru: Подставим −4 вместо x: 7 − 2(−4) = 7 + 8 = 15.

typicalErrors.en: Dropping the negative sign on the input.
typicalErrors.ru: Потеря минуса у аргумента.

exercises.prompt: Which expression is equivalent to 3(2x − 5) + 4x?

hints.en: Multiply every term inside the parentheses by 3.
hints.ru: Умножьте каждое слагаемое в скобках на 3.

hints.en: Combine the two terms containing x.
hints.ru: Сложите два слагаемых с x.

explanation.en: Distribution gives 6x − 15 + 4x. Combine 6x and 4x to obtain 10x − 15.
explanation.ru: Раскроем скобки: 6x − 15 + 4x. Сложив 6x и 4x, получим 10x − 15.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying only the first term inside the parentheses.
typicalErrors.ru: Умножение только первого слагаемого в скобках.

exercises.prompt: The graph of 4x + 3y = 24 intersects the x-axis at (a, 0). What is a?

hints.en: Which coordinate equals zero on the x-axis?
hints.ru: Какая координата равна нулю на оси x?

hints.en: Substitute y = 0 into the equation.
hints.ru: Подставьте y = 0 в уравнение.

explanation.en: On the x-axis y is 0, so 4a = 24 and a = 6.
explanation.ru: На оси x координата y равна 0. Поэтому 4a = 24 и a = 6.

typicalErrors.en: Setting x to zero and finding the y-intercept.
typicalErrors.ru: Подстановка x = 0 и поиск пересечения с осью y.

exercises.prompt: The quantities x and y satisfy y = kx for a constant k. When x = 6, y = 21. What is k?

hints.en: Use the given pair in y = kx.
hints.ru: Подставьте данную пару в y = kx.

hints.en: Divide y by x to find the constant.
hints.ru: Чтобы найти коэффициент, разделите y на x.

explanation.en: Substitution gives 21 = 6k, so k = 21/6 = 7/2.
explanation.ru: Подстановка даёт 21 = 6k, поэтому k = 21/6 = 7/2.

typicalErrors.en: Reversing the ratio x and y.
typicalErrors.ru: Перестановка x и y в отношении.

exercises.prompt: A librarian begins with 140 bookmarks. After giving the same number b of bookmarks to each of 8 classes, 36 bookmarks remain. Which equation represents this situation?

hints.en: Find the total number of bookmarks given away.
hints.ru: Выразите общее число розданных закладок.

hints.en: The initial amount minus the amount given away equals the remainder.
hints.ru: Начальное количество минус розданное равно остатку.

explanation.en: Eight classes receive 8b bookmarks altogether. Subtracting that total from 140 leaves 36, so 140 − 8b = 36.
explanation.ru: Восьми классам раздали всего 8b закладок. После вычитания из 140 остаётся 36: 140 − 8b = 36.

typicalErrors.en: Subtracting b just once although there are eight classes.
typicalErrors.ru: Вычитание b один раз вместо восьми.

exercises.prompt: Which of the following values of x satisfies both x > −2 and 2x + 1 < 5?

hints.en: A value must satisfy both conditions.
hints.ru: Значение должно удовлетворять обоим условиям.

hints.en: Solve the second inequality and intersect the allowed intervals.
hints.ru: Решите второе неравенство и найдите пересечение промежутков.

explanation.en: The second inequality gives x < 2. Together the conditions require −2 < x < 2; only 0 is listed in that interval.
explanation.ru: Второе неравенство даёт x < 2. Вместе условия требуют −2 < x < 2; из предложенных значений подходит только 0.

typicalErrors.en: Including an endpoint when the inequality is strict.
typicalErrors.ru: Включение границы при строгом неравенстве.

exercises.prompt: For the function g(x) = 5x + 12, what is the value of g(9) − g(7)?

hints.en: Evaluate both function values, or use the slope.
hints.ru: Вычислите оба значения функции или используйте наклон.

hints.en: The constant 12 cancels in the subtraction.
hints.ru: При вычитании постоянное слагаемое 12 сокращается.

explanation.en: g(9) = 57 and g(7) = 47, so their difference is 10. Equivalently, the input increases by 2 and the slope is 5.
explanation.ru: g(9) = 57, g(7) = 47, разность равна 10. Также можно умножить изменение аргумента 2 на наклон 5.

typicalErrors.en: Adding the constant twice instead of subtracting the full function values.
typicalErrors.ru: Сложение постоянных вместо вычитания полных значений функции.

exercises.prompt: Each list gives y-values at x = 0, 1, 2, and 3, in that order. Which list could come from a linear function?

hints.en: Compare consecutive differences, not ratios.
hints.ru: Сравните соседние разности, а не отношения.

hints.en: Check whether all three differences in a list are equal.
hints.ru: Проверьте, равны ли все три разности в списке.

explanation.en: For equal input steps a linear function has constant output differences. The differences in 11, 8, 5, 2 are all −3; the other lists do not have constant differences.
explanation.ru: При равных шагах аргумента линейная функция имеет постоянные разности значений. В списке 11, 8, 5, 2 все разности равны −3; в остальных они различаются.

typicalErrors.en: Treating a constant ratio as evidence of a linear function.
typicalErrors.ru: Постоянное отношение ошибочно принимается за признак линейности.

exercises.prompt: A shipment must contain at least 60 notebooks. It has 4 boxes with n notebooks in each box and 8 loose notebooks. Which inequality expresses this requirement?

hints.en: Write the total number of notebooks first.
hints.ru: Сначала выразите общее число тетрадей.

hints.en: “At least” means greater than or equal to.
hints.ru: «Не менее» означает больше или равно.

explanation.en: The shipment contains 4n + 8 notebooks. “At least 60” includes 60 and all larger totals, giving 4n + 8 ≥ 60.
explanation.ru: В отправлении 4n + 8 тетрадей. «Не менее 60» включает 60 и большие значения, поэтому 4n + 8 ≥ 60.

typicalErrors.en: Reversing the inequality or multiplying the loose notebooks by four.
typicalErrors.ru: Неверный знак неравенства или умножение отдельных тетрадей на четыре.

exercises.prompt: A museum sold 42 tickets. Adult tickets cost $12 each and student tickets cost $7 each. Total ticket revenue was $394. How many adult tickets were sold?

hints.en: Use the total ticket count to build a baseline.
hints.ru: Используйте общее число билетов для базового расчёта.

hints.en: Compare actual revenue with the revenue if every ticket were a student ticket.
hints.ru: Сравните выручку с суммой, если бы все билеты были ученическими.

explanation.en: If all 42 tickets cost $7, revenue would be $294. Each adult ticket adds $5, so there were (394 − 294)/5 = 20 adult tickets.
explanation.ru: Если бы все 42 билета стоили $7, выручка составила бы $294. Каждый взрослый билет добавляет $5, поэтому их (394 − 294)/5 = 20.

typicalErrors.en: Dividing total revenue by the adult price without accounting for student tickets.
typicalErrors.ru: Деление выручки на взрослую цену без учёта ученических билетов.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A course grade is 40% of a project score plus 60% of an exam score. Maya earned 85 on the project. What exam score gives her a course grade of 88?

hints.en: Write an equation using the two weights.
hints.ru: Составьте уравнение с двумя весами.
Решите 34 + 0,6e = 88.

explanation.en: The project contributes 0.4(85) = 34 points. The exam must contribute 88 − 34 = 54, so its score is 54/0.6 = 90.
explanation.ru: Проект даёт 0,4(85) = 34 балла. Экзамен должен дать 88 − 34 = 54, поэтому его результат равен 54/0,6 = 90.

typicalErrors.en: Taking an unweighted average of the two scores.
typicalErrors.ru: Вычисление среднего без учёта весов.

exercises.prompt: A line has slope −3/2 and passes through (4, −1). What is the y-coordinate of the point on this line with x-coordinate 10?

hints.en: Use the change in x from the known point.
hints.ru: Найдите изменение x относительно известной точки.

hints.en: Multiply 10 − 4 by the slope, then add the initial y-value.
hints.ru: Умножьте 10 − 4 на наклон и прибавьте исходное y.

explanation.en: The x-coordinate increases by 6, so y changes by (−3/2)(6) = −9. Starting at −1 gives −10.
explanation.ru: Координата x увеличивается на 6, поэтому y изменяется на (−3/2)(6) = −9. От −1 получаем −10.

typicalErrors.en: Using x = 10 as the change in x.
typicalErrors.ru: Подмена изменения x самой координатой 10.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: If (2x − 1)/3 = (x + 5)/2, what is the value of x − 4?

hints.en: Clear the denominators before combining terms.
hints.ru: Устраните знаменатели перед приведением подобных слагаемых.

hints.en: After solving for x, subtract 4.
hints.ru: Найдя x, вычтите 4.

explanation.en: Cross-multiply: 4x − 2 = 3x + 15, so x = 17. The requested expression is 17 − 4 = 13.
explanation.ru: Умножим крест-накрест: 4x − 2 = 3x + 15, откуда x = 17. Требуемое выражение равно 17 − 4 = 13.

typicalErrors.en: Reporting x rather than the expression requested.
typicalErrors.ru: Ответ значением x вместо требуемого выражения.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The formula P = 2a + 2b gives a rectangle’s perimeter. Which expression gives b in terms of P and a?

hints.en: Isolate the term containing b.
hints.ru: Выделите слагаемое с b.

hints.en: Divide both terms of P − 2a by 2.
hints.ru: Разделите оба слагаемых P − 2a на 2.

explanation.en: Subtract 2a from both sides to get 2b = P − 2a, then divide the entire right side by 2.
explanation.ru: Вычтем 2a из обеих частей: 2b = P − 2a. Затем разделим всю правую часть на 2.

typicalErrors.en: Dividing only one term by two.
typicalErrors.ru: Деление на два только одного слагаемого.

exercises.prompt: A sensor displays y = 2.5x + 6, where x is time in minutes. If time is instead measured as t seconds, which equation gives the same displayed value?

hints.en: Express the number of minutes using the number of seconds.
hints.ru: Выразите число минут через число секунд.

hints.en: Replace x with t/60 in the original equation.
hints.ru: Замените x на t/60 в исходном уравнении.

explanation.en: Since x = t/60, substitution gives y = 2.5(t/60) + 6 = t/24 + 6. The initial value stays 6.
explanation.ru: Так как x = t/60, подстановка даёт y = 2,5(t/60) + 6 = t/24 + 6. Начальное значение остаётся 6.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying the rate by 60 when converting a per-minute rate to a per-second rate.
typicalErrors.ru: Умножение на 60 при переходе от скорости за минуту к скорости за секунду.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The linear function h(x) = ax + b satisfies h(2) = 11 and h(−1) = 2. What is h(0)?

hints.en: Use the two function values to find a.
hints.ru: Используйте два значения функции, чтобы найти a.

hints.en: The value at x = 0 equals the constant b.
hints.ru: Значение при x = 0 равно постоянному слагаемому b.

explanation.ru: Наклон равен (11 − 2)/(2 − (−1)) = 3. Из h(2) = 11 получаем b = 11 − 6 = 5, поэтому h(0) = 5.

typicalErrors.en: Averaging the outputs even though zero is not midway between the inputs.
typicalErrors.ru: Усреднение значений, хотя ноль не лежит посередине между аргументами.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The numbers x and y satisfy 3x + 2y = 19 and x − 2y = 1. What is the value of 2x?

hints.en: Look for terms that cancel when the equations are added.
hints.ru: Найдите слагаемые, сокращающиеся при сложении уравнений.

hints.en: You can find 2x without finding y.
hints.ru: Можно найти 2x, не вычисляя y.

explanation.en: Adding the equations gives 4x = 20. Dividing by 2 gives the requested quantity 2x = 10.
explanation.ru: Сложение уравнений даёт 4x = 20. Разделив на 2, получаем требуемое 2x = 10.

typicalErrors.en: Returning x when the question asks for 2x.
typicalErrors.ru: Ответ значением x, когда требуется 2x.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The graph of y = 4x − 7 is shifted 3 units to the left. What is the y-intercept of the resulting graph?

hints.en: A horizontal shift changes the input inside the function.
hints.ru: Горизонтальный сдвиг изменяет аргумент внутри функции.

hints.en: For a shift left, evaluate the old function at x + 3.
hints.ru: При сдвиге влево вычисляйте исходную функцию от x + 3.

explanation.en: A left shift of 3 replaces x with x + 3. The new equation is y = 4(x + 3) − 7 = 4x + 5, so the y-intercept is 5.
explanation.ru: Сдвиг влево на 3 означает замену x на x + 3. Новое уравнение: y = 4(x + 3) − 7 = 4x + 5. Пересечение с осью y равно 5.

typicalErrors.en: Subtracting 3 from the output for a horizontal shift.
typicalErrors.ru: Вычитание 3 из значения функции при горизонтальном сдвиге.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A parking garage charges $6 for the first 2 hours and $2.50 for each additional hour. A car stays for a whole number of hours and the charge is $16. How many hours did the car stay?

hints.en: Separate the initial block from additional hours.
hints.ru: Отделите первые два часа от дополнительных.

hints.en: Find the additional hours, then add 2.
hints.ru: Найдите дополнительные часы и затем прибавьте 2.

explanation.en: The extra charge is 16 − 6 = 10 dollars, covering 10/2.5 = 4 additional hours. Including the first 2 hours gives 6 hours.
explanation.ru: Доплата равна 16 − 6 = 10 долларов и покрывает 10/2,5 = 4 дополнительных часа. Вместе с первыми двумя получается 6 часов.

typicalErrors.en: Applying the additional-hour rate to the entire stay.
typicalErrors.ru: Применение дополнительного тарифа ко всему времени стоянки.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A lab mixes a 10% salt solution with a 25% salt solution to obtain 60 liters of a 19% salt solution. Volumes are additive. How many liters of the 25% solution are used?

hints.en: Keep track of both total volume and the amount of salt.
hints.ru: Учитывайте общий объём и количество соли.

hints.en: Use 60 − v for the volume of the weaker solution.
hints.ru: Объём менее концентрированного раствора равен 60 − v.

explanation.en: Let v be the liters of 25% solution. Salt balance gives 0.25v + 0.10(60 − v) = 0.19(60), so 0.15v = 5.4 and v = 36.
explanation.ru: Пусть v — литры 25%-го раствора. Баланс соли: 0,25v + 0,10(60 − v) = 0,19(60). Тогда 0,15v = 5,4 и v = 36.

typicalErrors.en: Using the final concentration as the simple average of the two percentages.
typicalErrors.ru: Простое усреднение концентраций вместо учёта объёмов.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: Initially, the numbers of books on shelves A and B are in the ratio 5:3. After 12 books move from A to B, both shelves hold the same number. How many books were initially on shelf A?

hints.en: Represent the ratio using a shared multiplier.
hints.ru: Запишите отношение через общий множитель.

hints.en: The move subtracts 12 from A and adds 12 to B.
hints.ru: Перенос уменьшает A на 12 и увеличивает B на 12.

explanation.en: Write the initial counts as 5k and 3k. Equality after the move gives 5k − 12 = 3k + 12, so 2k = 24 and k = 12. Shelf A initially held 60 books.
explanation.ru: Начальные количества обозначим 5k и 3k. После переноса 5k − 12 = 3k + 12, поэтому 2k = 24 и k = 12. На A было 60 книг.

typicalErrors.en: Changing only one shelf when transferring books.
typicalErrors.ru: Изменение количества только на одной полке при переносе.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: For a constant k, the equation 3(kx − 2) = 5x + k has the solution x = 2. What is k?

hints.en: Use the prescribed solution before trying to isolate x.
hints.ru: Подставьте заданное решение до выделения x.

hints.en: Collect all terms containing k on one side.
hints.ru: Перенесите все слагаемые с k в одну часть.

explanation.en: Substitute x = 2: 6k − 6 = 10 + k. Thus 5k = 16 and k = 16/5. The coefficient 3k − 5 is then nonzero, so this is a valid linear equation with that solution.
explanation.ru: Подставим x = 2: 6k − 6 = 10 + k. Значит, 5k = 16 и k = 16/5. Коэффициент 3k − 5 не равен нулю, поэтому решение допустимо.

typicalErrors.en: Treating k as the requested value of x.
typicalErrors.ru: Смешение параметра k со значением x.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The expressions 4(ax − 3) + bx and 7x − 12 are equal for every real x. If a − b = 2, what is a?

hints.en: An identity must match coefficients as well as constants.
hints.ru: В тождестве должны совпадать коэффициенты и свободные члены.

hints.en: Combine 4a + b = 7 with a − b = 2.
hints.ru: Объедините 4a + b = 7 и a − b = 2.

explanation.en: Matching x-coefficients gives 4a + b = 7. Since b = a − 2, we get 5a − 2 = 7 and a = 9/5. The constant terms already agree.
explanation.ru: Сравнение коэффициентов при x даёт 4a + b = 7. Так как b = a − 2, имеем 5a − 2 = 7 и a = 9/5. Свободные члены уже совпадают.

typicalErrors.en: Choosing one convenient x-value and treating it as proof of an identity.
typicalErrors.ru: Проверка одного x вместо сравнения тождественных выражений.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A line is perpendicular to 5x − 2y = 11 and passes through (4, 3). What is its y-intercept? Enter an exact fraction.

hints.en: Perpendicular nonvertical lines have slopes whose product is −1.
hints.ru: Произведение наклонов перпендикулярных невертикальных прямых равно −1.

hints.en: Use slope −2/5 and substitute the given point into y = mx + b.
hints.ru: Используйте наклон −2/5 и подставьте данную точку в y = mx + b.

explanation.en: The given line has slope 5/2, so the perpendicular slope is −2/5. Write y = (−2/5)x + b and use (4, 3): b = 3 + 8/5 = 23/5.
explanation.ru: Наклон данной прямой 5/2, перпендикулярной — −2/5. Из y = (−2/5)x + b и точки (4, 3) получаем b = 3 + 8/5 = 23/5.

typicalErrors.en: Negating the slope without also taking its reciprocal.
typicalErrors.ru: Изменение знака наклона без перехода к обратной величине.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The numbers x and y satisfy 4x + 7y = 30 and 2x + 5y = 18. What is the value of 6x + 9y?

hints.en: Look for a combination of the left sides that matches the target.
hints.ru: Ищите комбинацию левых частей, совпадающую с целью.

hints.en: Try twice the first equation minus the second.
hints.ru: Попробуйте из удвоенного первого уравнения вычесть второе.

explanation.en: Twice the first equation minus the second gives (8x + 14y) − (2x + 5y) = 60 − 18. Therefore 6x + 9y = 42.
explanation.ru: Удвоенное первое уравнение минус второе даёт (8x + 14y) − (2x + 5y) = 60 − 18. Поэтому 6x + 9y = 42.

typicalErrors.en: Adding the equations without checking the target coefficients.
typicalErrors.ru: Сложение уравнений без проверки требуемых коэффициентов.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The formula 1/R = 1/a + 1/b applies to positive a, b, and R. If a = 12 and R = 8, what is b?

hints.en: Solve for the reciprocal of b first.
hints.ru: Сначала найдите обратную величину 1/b.

hints.en: Use a common denominator for 1/8 − 1/12, then invert.
hints.ru: Приведите 1/8 − 1/12 к общему знаменателю, затем найдите обратную величину.

explanation.en: Isolate 1/b: 1/b = 1/8 − 1/12 = 1/24. Taking the reciprocal gives b = 24.
explanation.ru: Выделим 1/b: 1/b = 1/8 − 1/12 = 1/24. Обратная величина даёт b = 24.

typicalErrors.en: Subtracting the denominators as though fractions were whole numbers.
typicalErrors.ru: Вычитание знаменателей как целых чисел.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A club buys notebooks for $3 each and folders for $2 each. It buys 25 items for $64. How many more notebooks than folders does it buy?

hints.en: Use the total number and total cost together.
hints.ru: Используйте общее количество вместе с общей стоимостью.

hints.en: Find each count before subtracting folders from notebooks.
hints.ru: Найдите оба количества, затем вычтите папки из тетрадей.

explanation.en: If all items were folders, they would cost $50. The $14 excess means 14 notebooks, leaving 11 folders. The difference is 14 − 11 = 3.
explanation.ru: Если бы все предметы были папками, они стоили бы $50. Дополнительные $14 означают 14 тетрадей и 11 папок. Разность 14 − 11 = 3.

typicalErrors.en: Reporting the number of notebooks instead of the difference.
typicalErrors.ru: Ответ количеством тетрадей вместо разности.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: Plan A charges $28 plus $0.18 per printed page. Plan B charges $10 plus $0.30 per printed page. What is the least whole number of pages for which Plan A costs less than Plan B?

hints.en: Set up a strict comparison between the full costs.
hints.ru: Сравните полные стоимости строгим неравенством.

hints.en: After finding the break-even number, move to the next integer.
hints.ru: Найдя число равных стоимостей, перейдите к следующему целому.

explanation.en: 28 + 0.18p < 10 + 0.30p implies 18 < 0.12p, so p > 150. The least whole number is 151; at 150 the plans cost the same.
explanation.ru: Из 28 + 0,18p < 10 + 0,30p следует 18 < 0,12p, то есть p > 150. Наименьшее целое — 151; при 150 цены равны.

typicalErrors.en: Including the break-even point in a strict inequality.
typicalErrors.ru: Включение точки равенства в строгое неравенство.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A workshop makes stools and benches. Each stool uses 2 boards and each bench uses 5 boards. It has 43 boards, must make exactly 11 items, and makes a whole number of each item. What is the greatest number of benches it can make?

hints.en: Express the stool count using the bench count.
hints.ru: Выразите число табуретов через число скамеек.

hints.en: Combine the exact item count with the board limit.
hints.ru: Объедините точное число изделий с ограничением досок.

explanation.en: Let b be benches and 11 − b be stools. Then 5b + 2(11 − b) ≤ 43, giving 3b ≤ 21 and b ≤ 7. Seven benches and four stools use all 43 boards.
explanation.ru: Пусть b — число скамеек, тогда табуретов 11 − b. Из 5b + 2(11 − b) ≤ 43 получаем 3b ≤ 21 и b ≤ 7. Семь скамеек и четыре табурета используют 43 доски.

typicalErrors.en: Using all boards for benches while ignoring the required total of 11 items.
typicalErrors.ru: Расходование всех досок на скамейки без учёта 11 изделий.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: What is the value of (2⁵ × 2³)/2⁴?

hints.en: The powers all have the same base.
hints.ru: У всех степеней одинаковое основание.

hints.en: Combine the exponents as 5 + 3 − 4.
hints.ru: Объедините показатели: 5 + 3 − 4.

explanation.en: Add exponents in the numerator and subtract the denominator exponent: 2^(5 + 3 − 4) = 2⁴ = 16.
explanation.ru: При умножении складываем показатели, при делении вычитаем: 2^(5 + 3 − 4) = 2⁴ = 16.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying the exponents when multiplying powers.
typicalErrors.ru: Умножение показателей при умножении степеней.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: Which expression is equivalent to (x + 6)²?

hints.en: A square of a sum includes a middle term.
hints.ru: Квадрат суммы содержит среднее слагаемое.

hints.en: Use x² + 2(x)(6) + 6².
hints.ru: Используйте x² + 2(x)(6) + 6².

explanation.en: Multiply (x + 6)(x + 6). The two cross-products are 6x each, giving x² + 12x + 36.
explanation.ru: Перемножим (x + 6)(x + 6). Два перекрёстных произведения равны 6x каждое, поэтому получаем x² + 12x + 36.

typicalErrors.en: Squaring each term separately and omitting the cross-products.
typicalErrors.ru: Отдельное возведение слагаемых в квадрат без перекрёстных произведений.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: For p(x) = x³ − 2x² + 5, what is p(−2)?

hints.en: Evaluate powers before multiplying by their coefficients.
hints.ru: Сначала вычислите степени, затем умножайте на коэффициенты.

explanation.en: p(−2) = −8 − 2(4) + 5 = −11. The odd power is negative and the even power is positive.
explanation.ru: p(−2) = −8 − 2(4) + 5 = −11. Нечётная степень отрицательна, чётная положительна.

typicalErrors.en: Treating the square of a negative input as negative.
typicalErrors.ru: Отрицательный результат при возведении отрицательного аргумента в квадрат.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The expression √72 is equal to a√2, where a is positive. What is a?

hints.en: Find a perfect-square factor of 72.
hints.ru: Найдите в 72 множитель, являющийся полным квадратом.
Используйте 72 = 36 × 2.

explanation.ru: Так как 72 = 36 × 2, имеем √72 = √36 × √2 = 6√2, поэтому a = 6.

typicalErrors.en: Taking half the radicand instead of extracting a square factor.
typicalErrors.ru: Деление подкоренного числа пополам вместо выделения полного квадрата.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A sample has mass m(t) = 160(1/2)^t grams after t days. According to the model, how many grams remain after 2 days?

hints.en: Substitute t = 2 into the exponent.
hints.ru: Подставьте t = 2 в показатель степени.

hints.en: Halve the initial mass twice.
hints.ru: Дважды уменьшите начальную массу вдвое.

explanation.en: Two days give two factors of 1/2: 160(1/2)² = 40 grams.
explanation.ru: За два дня применяются два множителя 1/2: 160(1/2)² = 40 граммов.

typicalErrors.en: Subtracting the same number of grams each day.
typicalErrors.ru: Вычитание одинакового числа граммов каждый день.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: What is the value of 27^(2/3)?

hints.en: The denominator of the exponent identifies the root.
hints.ru: Знаменатель показателя определяет степень корня.

hints.en: Take the cube root first, then square.
hints.ru: Сначала извлеките кубический корень, затем возведите в квадрат.

explanation.en: The cube root of 27 is 3. Squaring it gives 3² = 9.
explanation.ru: Кубический корень из 27 равен 3. Его квадрат 3² = 9.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying 27 by 2/3 instead of applying a fractional exponent.
typicalErrors.ru: Умножение 27 на 2/3 вместо возведения в дробную степень.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: Which expression is equivalent to 6x³ − 9x²?

hints.en: Find a factor shared by both coefficients and powers.
hints.ru: Найдите общий множитель коэффициентов и степеней.

hints.en: Divide each term by 3x².
hints.ru: Разделите каждое слагаемое на 3x².

explanation.en: Both terms share 3x². Dividing the terms by that factor leaves 2x and −3, so the factorization is 3x²(2x − 3).
explanation.ru: Общий множитель — 3x². После деления слагаемых на него остаются 2x и −3, поэтому разложение равно 3x²(2x − 3).

typicalErrors.en: Removing a factor without reducing the powers inside the parentheses.
typicalErrors.ru: Вынесение множителя без уменьшения степеней в скобках.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The function q(x) = (x + 2)(x − 7) is written as q(x) = x² + bx + c. What is b?

hints.en: Look for the terms that contain exactly one factor of x.
hints.ru: Найдите произведения, содержащие ровно один множитель x.

hints.en: Add the coefficients from −7x and 2x.
hints.ru: Сложите коэффициенты при −7x и 2x.

explanation.en: Expand to x² − 7x + 2x − 14. The x-coefficient is −7 + 2 = −5.
explanation.ru: Раскрывая скобки, получаем x² − 7x + 2x − 14. Коэффициент при x равен −7 + 2 = −5.

typicalErrors.en: Returning the constant product −14 instead of the x-coefficient.
typicalErrors.ru: Ответ свободным членом −14 вместо коэффициента при x.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A positive function has values f(0) = 5, f(1) = 15, f(2) = 45, and f(3) = 135. Which model agrees with all four values?

hints.en: Check both the initial value and the repeated factor.
hints.ru: Проверьте начальное значение и повторяющийся множитель.

hints.en: At x = 0 the exponential factor must equal 1.
hints.ru: При x = 0 степенной множитель должен равняться 1.

explanation.en: The initial value is 5 and each output is three times the previous one. Thus f(x) = 5 · 3^x matches all four points.
explanation.ru: Начальное значение 5, каждое следующее втрое больше предыдущего. Поэтому f(x) = 5 · 3^x подходит ко всем четырём точкам.

typicalErrors.en: Using the multiplier as the initial value.
typicalErrors.ru: Подмена начального значения множителем роста.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: For the function r(x) = (x + 4)/(x² − 9), which pair lists all real values excluded from the domain?

hints.en: Only zeros of the denominator restrict this rational function.
hints.ru: Область определения дроби ограничивают нули знаменателя.

hints.en: Solve x² − 9 = 0.
hints.ru: Решите x² − 9 = 0.

explanation.en: The denominator cannot be zero. Since x² − 9 = (x − 3)(x + 3), the excluded inputs are −3 and 3.
explanation.ru: Знаменатель не может равняться нулю. Разложение x² − 9 = (x − 3)(x + 3) исключает аргументы −3 и 3.

typicalErrors.en: Excluding a zero of the numerator rather than the denominator.
typicalErrors.ru: Исключение нуля числителя вместо нулей знаменателя.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The function f(t) = a · b^t has a > 0 and b > 0. If f(0) = 12 and f(2) = 108, what is b?

hints.en: Use t = 0 to determine a.
hints.ru: Используйте t = 0, чтобы найти a.

hints.en: After dividing 108 by 12, take the positive square root.
hints.ru: Разделив 108 на 12, извлеките положительный квадратный корень.

explanation.en: f(0) = a = 12. Then 12b² = 108, so b² = 9. The condition b > 0 selects b = 3.
explanation.ru: f(0) = a = 12. Тогда 12b² = 108 и b² = 9. Условие b > 0 даёт b = 3.

typicalErrors.en: Using the two-step multiplier 9 as the one-step multiplier.
typicalErrors.ru: Подмена множителя за один шаг множителем 9 за два шага.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The graph of y = 2x² − 12x + 7 has a vertex at (h, k). What is h?

hints.en: Identify the coefficients of x² and x.
hints.ru: Определите коэффициенты при x² и x.

hints.en: Use h = −b/(2a), with a = 2 and b = −12.
hints.ru: Используйте h = −b/(2a), где a = 2, b = −12.

explanation.en: The vertex input is −b/(2a) = 12/4 = 3. Equivalently, y = 2(x − 3)² − 11.
explanation.ru: Абсцисса вершины −b/(2a) = 12/4 = 3. Также y = 2(x − 3)² − 11.

typicalErrors.en: Reporting the minimum output instead of the vertex input.
typicalErrors.ru: Ответ минимальным значением функции вместо аргумента вершины.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: For x ≠ 0 and x ≠ −2, the expression (x² + 5x + 6)/(x² + 2x) equals (x + c)/x. What is c?

hints.en: Factor both polynomials before canceling.
hints.ru: Разложите оба многочлена до сокращения.

hints.en: Use 2 and 3, whose sum is 5 and product is 6.
hints.ru: Используйте 2 и 3: их сумма 5, произведение 6.

explanation.en: Factor the numerator as (x + 2)(x + 3) and denominator as x(x + 2). Cancel x + 2 under the stated restrictions, leaving (x + 3)/x.
explanation.ru: Числитель равен (x + 2)(x + 3), знаменатель — x(x + 2). При данных ограничениях сокращаем x + 2 и получаем (x + 3)/x.

typicalErrors.en: Canceling individual terms across a sum.
typicalErrors.ru: Сокращение отдельных слагаемых внутри суммы.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The equation 3x² − 11x + 6 = 0 has roots r and s. What is rs?

hints.en: You need the product, not the individual roots.
hints.ru: Нужно произведение, а не отдельные корни.

hints.en: Divide the constant term by the coefficient of x².
hints.ru: Разделите свободный член на коэффициент при x².

explanation.en: For ax² + bx + c = 0, the product of the roots is c/a. Here rs = 6/3 = 2. Factoring as (3x − 2)(x − 3) confirms roots 2/3 and 3.
explanation.ru: Для ax² + bx + c = 0 произведение корней равно c/a. Здесь rs = 6/3 = 2. Разложение (3x − 2)(x − 3) подтверждает корни 2/3 и 3.

typicalErrors.en: Using the root sum −b/a when the product is requested.
typicalErrors.ru: Использование суммы корней −b/a вместо произведения.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A population model is P(t) = 200 · 2^(t/3), where t is measured in years. Which expression is equal to P(6u) for all real u?

hints.en: Simplify the exponent after substituting.
hints.ru: Упростите показатель после подстановки.

hints.en: Use the power rule a^(bu) = (a^b)^u.
hints.ru: Используйте правило a^(bu) = (a^b)^u.

explanation.en: Substitute 6u for t: 200 · 2^(2u). Since 2^(2u) = (2²)^u = 4^u, the expression is 200 · 4^u.
explanation.ru: Подставим 6u вместо t: 200 · 2^(2u). Так как 2^(2u) = (2²)^u = 4^u, получаем 200 · 4^u.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying the initial population by 6 instead of replacing the time input.
typicalErrors.ru: Умножение начальной численности на 6 вместо замены аргумента времени.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: What value of x satisfies 3√(2x + 1) = 15?

hints.en: Isolate the square root before squaring.
hints.ru: Выделите квадратный корень перед возведением в квадрат.

hints.en: After squaring, solve 2x + 1 = 25.
hints.ru: После возведения в квадрат решите 2x + 1 = 25.

explanation.en: Divide by 3 to get √(2x + 1) = 5. Square: 2x + 1 = 25, so x = 12. Check: 3√25 = 15.
explanation.ru: Разделим на 3: √(2x + 1) = 5. После возведения в квадрат 2x + 1 = 25, откуда x = 12. Проверка: 3√25 = 15.

typicalErrors.en: Squaring only the radicand and forgetting the outside coefficient.
typicalErrors.ru: Возведение в квадрат без учёта коэффициента перед корнем.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored expansion, 2026-09-05; AI draft; independent subject-expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The graphs y = x² and y = 2x + 8 intersect at two points. What is the sum of the x-coordinates of those points?
